# Fixtures

`builtInSummary.txt` is the `instructions` text of `SkillStore.builtInSummary` from
`Sources/Summarization/SkillStore.swift` in the `notecapture` repo (the S1ft app), at commit
`65f5b85265b34787232e6051f375b1f04742a4c5` ("Summary built-in: merge the two action-item owner
rules into one (#204)"). The Swift indentation and the `\` line continuations are resolved, as
the Swift compiler does. The file ends with one newline.

When `builtInSummary` changes, update this file and `skills/summary/SKILL.md` together.
